title: Last Rites
summary: Sister Ilse at the Shrine of the Ember says nobody said the last rites for the dead legion in the Old Barrows. Hold where they fell while they're said, and she'll teach your clerics a blessing (the cleric's level-6 skill).

steps.journal: Go down to the Old Barrows' second floor or deeper, and hold a stair hall (the room with the stairs down) for five waves.

objectives.label: Waves held in a stair hall, floor 2 or deeper

ready: Go back to Sister Ilse at the Shrine of the Ember in Thornwick.
done: Ilse taught your clerics Bless: the rites said forward, for the living, which she says is the only direction that helps.
